title: Grateful Dead Live at West High Auditorium on 1980-06-19
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi DR-1)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Mark Severson's Master  Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics (mounted on pole, Row M, Seat 12, left side) > Sony TC-D5(2 Maxell XLII's, 1 Maxell UDXLI)

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording with a missing early Jerry lead on the China>Rider segue, but overall a strong show.
ai_review.review: The audience tape captures an enjoyable performance, though the mix drops Jerry’s guitar for much of the China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider sequence until midway through Rider. Aside from that flaw the show is loved by the reviewer and the copy is considered a worthwhile listen.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; it rates the release 4 stars, praising the show while noting a specific recording flaw, leading to an overall strong but not perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear audience tape, but Jerry Garcia's guitar is buried in the mix during the early part of the China>Rider sequence.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer highlights the China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider segue as a key moment, with no complaints about overall pacing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar is missing early in the China>Rider sequence but later delivers monumental leads.
